newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - NOV 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - NOV 11.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

John Major will make the strength of the economy the cornerstone of his campaign for re-election today. His speech at the Lord Mayor's Banquet tonight will claim that the rest of the world is increasingly aware of Britain's economic success.
CBI CHIEF URGES ACTION TO SPEED UP GROWTH

The president of the Confederation of British Industry, Sir Colin Marshall, has criticised the lack of investment in the British economy, and challenged the government to create conditions which will foster better investment and increased growth.

James Sherwood is considering splitting up his Sea Containers group in a similar vein to that seen at Hanson. This could mean a separate London listing for the group's luxury hotel interests. Sherwood is known to want to purchase the Savoy group of hotels.
CHINESE JAIL THREAT TO FOREIGN BUSINESSMEN

Increasingly, foreigners convicted of transgressing local Chinese laws may face unlimited detention without charges. At present, Edith Xu Yi-chun, a Chinese national who is employed by Royal Dutch/Shell, has been held by the Chinese authorities for nearly a year on suspicion of divulging state secrets, but not formally charged.
